title: TABLE 66 WU JEN SPELLS - the full spell list by level with the elemental marks
audit_label: R669 OA wu jen spell list audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-six (capture pp. 153-155): Table 66 - the wu jen spell list by level, the per-level spell counts with the elemental marks, cross-checked level by level between the passes

banner.title: TABLE 66 WU JEN SPELLS, printed capture pp. 153-155 - the OA wu jen spell list round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 153-155; compressed pp. 74-75); all nine level columns cross-checked name by name between the passes. The roster: 30 first and second level spells, 24 each at the third through sixth, 12 seventh, 14 eighth and 13 ninth - 195 spells total, the ordinal max 30. One contested name: the sixth level Glassee reads Glasses in the print OCR against Glassee in the compressed - the compressed settles the known PHB spell name. The other OCR variances are typographic (the compressed Haute for Haste, Ventiloquism for Ventriloquism, the print's stray r on Duo-Dimension and the Power Word period artifacts). The distinctive wu jen structure pins as a 30 x 9 element grid, the R658 T62 pattern with elemental marks in place of the sohei and reversible columns: the codes 0 none, 1 Air, 2 Earth, 3 Fire, 4 Water, 5 Nature, 6 Wood, 7 All, 8 the cloudburst Water/Air dual and 9 the water to poison Nature/Water dual - the -99 sentinel padding the ordinals beyond each level's count. Earth is the most common element at 16 spells, Air 13, Fire 11, Water 10, Nature 7, the lone Wood mark (warp wood), four All marks (elemental burst, scry, elemental turning, conjure elemental) and the two duals - 64 tagged spells against 131 untagged. The spell names ride the column comments with the per-level tagged lists, the spell descriptions close in their own rounds. The memorization doctrine pins as the two consts: the six hours of restful meditation and the 3d6 starting-spell roll. The table tag WJT66Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
